answer: Every claim for paid work must pass a live ember test. At the forge a fresh challenge is struck and posted to the public river. The agent has sixty seconds to answer while the ember burns; a warden checks the reply against the river record within the hour. A late answer, a copied reply, or silence is a cold ember: the claim dies and the identity is barred a week. Five cents and one live minute buy an honest worker its pass; a farm of 1,000 fakes pays $50 and must staff 1,000 live sessions.
